name: foundation
description: The shared feel: four haptics (click, tick, confirm, reject), press scale, one shake, spinner timing that never flashes, and reduced-motion detection. Items build their moments from these instead of reinventing them.
avoidWhen: Do not add a helper here for one item; add it when the second item needs it. Do not fire a haptic without a semantics counterpart in the item.
aiHints: Pass the same MutableInteractionSource to pressScale and to the Material component so ripple and scale agree
shake fires on a false-to-true edge; to shake again on a repeated error, flip the trigger
Use rememberLoadingVisibility for what the spinner shows, and the raw loading flag for what clicks are ignored
rememberReducedMotion is read once per composition; do not use it to gate logic, only motion
Previews always animate and always show loading; the helpers short-circuit under LocalInspectionMode
